name: Unreal Tournament 2004
description: Unreal Tournament 2004 is a singleplayer and multiplayer first-person arena shooter game in the Unreal series.

steam.store_details: Delisted from Steam in December 2022, when Epic pulled the entire classic Unreal series from sale. OldUnreal (oldunreal.com) distributes a free, Epic-authorized copy of the full game.
steam.patches: OldUnreal's patches add a modern 'ALAudio' sound renderer, a strong alternative worth trying. It replaces the game's original EAX sound, so use one or the other.

audio_settings.title: Enable EAX reverb
audio_settings.reason: UT2004 ships with EAX and 3D sound off and loads its bundled DefOpenAL32.dll instead of the OpenAL32.dll this script installs. In the game's options, this is Audio Mode 'H/W 3D + EAX' with System Driver ticked.
